# apple_game_center_challenges (Data Source)

Lists the Game Center challenges of an app or of a group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_challenges" "app" {
  game_center_detail_id = data.apple_game_center_detail.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an app's Game Center detail. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.

### Read-Only

- `challenges` (Attributes List) The challenges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--challenges))

<a id="nestedatt--challenges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `challenges`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the challenge is archived.
- `challenge_type` (String) Kind of challenge: `LEADERBOARD`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the challenge.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the challenge in App Store Connect.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier the game knows the challenge by.
